lines.zh: 它缓缓接近，发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It approaches slowly, hissing softly.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁，如同幽灵。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam in the darkness, like ghosts.

lines.zh: 它爬行的声音令人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Its crawling sound sends shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 它发出沙哑的低吼，试图吓退你。
lines.en: It lets out a raspy growl to scare you away.

lines.zh: 它在你身边徘徊，似乎在等待。
lines.en: It circles around you, seemingly waiting.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着你，仿佛能看透你的梦。
lines.en: Its eyes stare into you as if seeing through your dreams.

lines.zh: 它的脚步声在寂静中显得格外刺耳。
lines.en: Its footsteps echo painfully in the silence.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶着，仿佛能感受到你的恐惧。
lines.en: It hisses, seeming to sense your fear.

lines.zh: 它缓缓爬行，不发出任何声音。
lines.en: It moves slowly, making no sound.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边低语，声音微弱却诡异。
lines.en: It whispers in your ear, a faint but eerie voice.

lines.zh: 压在你胸口，慢慢地挪。
lines.en: I press on your chest and inch along.

lines.zh: 我掀开被子一角，爬上来。
lines.en: I lift a corner of the blanket and climb up.

lines.zh: 它静静地站在那里，等待你的梦醒。
lines.en: It stands still, waiting for you to wake up.

lines.zh: 它静静地注视着，似乎在寻找猎物。
lines.en: It watches quietly, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 它凝视着虚空，仿佛在思考。
lines.en: It gazes into the void, as if thinking.

lines.zh: 它静悄悄地等待，仿佛时间停滞。
lines.en: It waits silently, as if time has stopped.

lines.zh: 它静静地等待，仿佛是梦的一部分。
lines.en: It waits quietly, as if part of the dream.

lines.zh: 它静静地站在角落，耐心等待。
lines.en: It stands quietly in the corner, patiently waiting.

lines.zh: 它静静地等待，仿佛在等待你的死亡。
lines.en: It waits quietly, as if waiting for your death.

lines.zh: 它静静地注视着，仿佛能预知未来。
lines.en: It watches quietly, as if foreseeing the future.

lines.zh: 它静静地等待，仿佛一切都在它的掌控中。
lines.en: It waits quietly, as if everything is under its control.

lines.zh: 它静静地等待，仿佛是命运的使者。
lines.en: It waits quietly, as if a harbinger of fate.

lines.zh: 停在你床边，听你的鼾声。
lines.en: I stop by your bed and listen to you snore.

lines.zh: 跪坐着，等梦做完。
lines.en: I kneel and wait for the dream to finish.

lines.zh: 一动不动，像压在被子上的重量。
lines.en: Still as the weight pressing on your blanket.

lines.zh: 手指按在你眼皮上。
lines.en: My finger rests on your eyelid.

lines.zh: 它的眼神紧紧锁住你，让你无法移开视线。
lines.en: Its gaze locks on you, making you unable to look away.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯住你，让你感到不适。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on you, making you uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 它盯着你看，似乎想窥探你的内心。
lines.en: It stares at you, as if trying to see into your soul.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛直视你，让你感到压迫。
lines.en: Its eyes stare at you, feeling oppressive.

lines.zh: 它死死盯着你，让你喘不过气来。
lines.en: It fixes its gaze on you, making you breathless.

lines.zh: 它的眼神令你不安，仿佛要穿透你的灵魂。
lines.en: Its gaze unsettles you, as if piercing your soul.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛紧紧盯着你，让你难以忍受。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on you, making you unbearable.

lines.zh: 它死死盯着你，让你感到恐惧。
lines.en: It stares at you, making you fearful.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着你，让你感到窒息。
lines.en: Its eyes stare at you, making you feel suffocated.

lines.zh: 它死死盯着你，让你感到绝望。
lines.en: It fixes its gaze on you, making you feel hopeless.

lines.zh: 凑近，看你眼皮下的梦。
lines.en: I lean in to watch the dream under your lids.

lines.zh: 瞳孔对准你闭着的眼睛。
lines.en: My pupils aim at your closed eyes.

lines.zh: 你在梦里，我也在看你。
lines.en: You are dreaming, and I am watching you.

lines.zh: 歪着头，研究你的睡相。
lines.en: I tilt my head and study how you sleep.

lines.zh: 盯着你，等你睁眼那一刻。
lines.en: I stare, waiting for the instant you open your eyes.

lines.zh: 把脸贴到你面前。
lines.en: I bring my face right up to yours.

lines.zh: 看你的喉咙起伏，数着。
lines.en: I watch your throat rise and fall, counting.

lines.zh: 你皱眉，我就笑了。
lines.en: You frown, and I smile.

lines.zh: 我要记住你梦里的脸。
lines.en: I will remember the face you wear in dreams.

lines.zh: 从床尾望过来，一直望到天亮。
lines.en: I watch from the foot of the bed until dawn.

lines.zh: 你感觉身体被缠住了，挣脱不了！
lines.en: You can't move!

lines.zh: 我让你动不了！
lines.en: You can't move!

lines.zh: 我的重量压在你的胸口。
lines.en: My weight presses on your chest.

lines.zh: 你被我困住了！
lines.en: You can't move!

lines.zh: 别想动弹！
lines.en: You can't move!

lines.zh: 动不了了，想哭啊！
lines.en: You can't move!

lines.zh: 我让你睡！
lines.en: You can't move!

lines.zh: 睡醒不了！
lines.en: You can't move!

lines.zh: 你的梦魇开始了！
lines.en: You can't move!

lines.zh: 我不会让你醒来的！
lines.en: You can't move!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，它缓缓靠近你，你却动弹不得。
lines.en: Hissss, it moves closer, yet you can't move.

lines.zh: 这怪物盯着你，让你无法思考。
lines.en: It stares, blocking your thoughts.

lines.zh: 你试图抓住它，但手却麻木了。
lines.en: You reach for it, but your hand feels numb.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛发出绿光，让你感到恐惧。
lines.en: Its green eyes shine, frightening you.

lines.zh: 你试图说话，但声音被卡住了。
lines.en: You try to speak, but your voice is stuck.

lines.zh: 它轻吻你的脸，却让你无法醒来。
lines.en: It kisses your face, keeping you asleep.

lines.zh: 你被它缠绕，无法挣脱。
lines.en: You are entangled, unable to break free.

lines.zh: 它散发出冰冷的气息，让你无法动弹。
lines.en: It exudes a cold breath, paralyzing you.

lines.zh: 你的身体被它固定，动弹不得。
lines.en: Your body is immobilized by it.

lines.zh: 它让你陷入梦境，无法醒来。
lines.en: It drags you into a dream, unable to wake.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，却被束缚住了。
lines.en: You collide with it, but are bound.

lines.zh: 它阻挡你的道路，你却动弹不得。
lines.en: It blocks your path, yet you can't move.

lines.zh: 你试图避开它，却撞了个满怀。
lines.en: You try to avoid it, but bump into it.

lines.zh: 它突然出现，你撞上它，无法动弹。
lines.en: It suddenly appears, you collide and can't move.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，它的触手抓住你。
lines.en: You collide, its tentacles grab you.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，被吸入它的洞穴。
lines.en: You collide, sucked into its lair.

lines.zh: 它突然撞上你，你却动弹不得。
lines.en: It collides with you, yet you can't move.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，它的触手缠绕你。
lines.en: You collide, its tentacles wrap around you.

lines.zh: 你试图逃跑，却被它撞住了。
lines.en: You try to escape, but are collided.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，却被紧紧包围。
lines.en: You collide, but are tightly enclosed.

lines.zh: 它缠住你的伴侣，让你无法分开。
lines.en: It entwines your partner, preventing separation.

lines.zh: 你试图靠近它，却被排斥。
lines.en: You try to approach it, but are repelled.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠绕你的伴侣，你无法阻止。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around your partner, stopping you.

lines.zh: 它紧紧缠住你的伴侣，你无法逃脱。
lines.en: It tightly binds your partner, preventing escape.

lines.zh: 你试图与它交流，但被拒绝。
lines.en: You try to communicate, but are rejected.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠绕你的伴侣，你无法挣脱。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around your partner, stopping you from escaping.

lines.zh: 你试图分开，却被它的力量压制。
lines.en: You try to separate, but are压制 by its strength.

lines.zh: 它的触手让你的伴侣无法动弹。
lines.en: Its tentacles immobilize your partner.

lines.zh: 你试图阻止它，却被它的力量压制。
lines.en: You try to stop it, but are压制 by its strength.

lines.zh: 它的存在让你们无法靠近。
lines.en: Its presence keeps you apart.

lines.zh: 软绵绵的触感让你害怕。
lines.en: Softness that terrifies you.

lines.zh: 触手慢慢靠近你的脸。
lines.en: Tentacles creep near your face.

lines.zh: 你的手臂突然失去知觉。
lines.en: Your arms suddenly lose feeling.

lines.zh: 你感到越来越沉重。
lines.en: You feel increasingly heavy.

lines.zh: 呼吸变得越来越困难。
lines.en: Breathing becomes harder.

lines.zh: 你的身体开始不受控制。
lines.en: Your body starts to uncontrol.

lines.zh: 声音越来越模糊。
lines.en: Voice becomes more blurred.

lines.zh: 你听不见任何声音。
lines.en: You can't hear anything.

lines.zh: 意识逐渐消失。
lines.en: Consciousness fades away.

lines.zh: 你发现自己无法醒来。
lines.en: You can't wake up.

lines.zh: 盯着你的双眼。
lines.en: Staring into your eyes.

lines.zh: 向你发出低沉的呜咽。
lines.en: Making a low moan at you.

lines.zh: 你睁不开眼，我就在这儿。
lines.en: You cannot open your eyes; I am right here.

lines.zh: 你仿佛被吸入了一个漩涡。
lines.en: You're pulled into a vortex.

lines.zh: 你的心跳变得不规律。
lines.en: Your heartbeat becomes irregular.

lines.zh: 你被无尽的黑暗包围。
lines.en: You're surrounded by endless darkness.

lines.zh: 你感到一阵寒冷。
lines.en: You feel a cold chill.

lines.zh: 你看到恐怖的幻象。
lines.en: You see horrifying visions.

lines.zh: 你无法挣脱束缚。
lines.en: You can't break free.

lines.zh: 你被紧紧抓住。
lines.en: You're tightly held.

lines.zh: 你翻了个身，被它按住了。
lines.en: You roll over, and it pins you down.

lines.zh: 呼吸乱了，它就知道了。
lines.en: Your breathing falters, and it knows.

lines.zh: 它先一步坐到你胸口。
lines.en: It sits on your chest before you can move.

lines.zh: 梦的门缝里，它挤了进来。
lines.en: It squeezes through the gap in your dream.

lines.zh: 你一动，它就跟上来。
lines.en: You stir, and it follows.

lines.zh: 它找到你了，在你睡着的时候。
lines.en: It found you while you were asleep.

lines.zh: 你被紧紧压住。
lines.en: You're pressed tightly.

lines.zh: 你感到一种无形的压迫。
lines.en: You feel an invisible pressure.

lines.zh: 你的心跳加速。
lines.en: Your heart speeds up.

lines.zh: 你的肌肉开始抽搐。
lines.en: Your muscles start to twitch.

lines.zh: 你开始喘不过气。
lines.en: You start to suffocate.

lines.zh: 你试图呼吸，却无法呼吸。
lines.en: You try to breathe, but can't.

lines.zh: 你感到极度的恐惧。
lines.en: You feel extreme fear.

lines.zh: 你的心跳声在耳畔回荡。
lines.en: Your heartbeat echoes in your ears.

lines.zh: 你试图挣扎，却无济于事。
lines.en: You struggle, but to no avail.

lines.zh: 你感到无法动弹。
lines.en: You feel unable to move.

lines.zh: 压住你的手脚，一寸不让。
lines.en: It holds your limbs down and yields nothing.

lines.zh: 让你喊不出声，也抬不起手。
lines.en: You cannot shout, and cannot lift a hand.

lines.zh: 它把枕头按在你脸上。
lines.en: It presses the pillow onto your face.

lines.zh: 你挣扎，它只是坐得更稳。
lines.en: You struggle, and it settles even heavier.

lines.zh: 梦里的路，它全都堵死了。
lines.en: Every road in the dream is blocked by it.

lines.zh: 数着你的心跳，等它停下。
lines.en: It counts your heartbeat, waiting for it to stop.

lines.zh: 被子越来越重了。
lines.en: The blanket grows heavier.

lines.zh: 你想起身，身体却不听话。
lines.en: You try to rise, but your body refuses.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的眼皮，不许你睁开。
lines.en: It stares at your eyelids and forbids them to open.

lines.zh: 再撑一会儿，你就醒不来了。
lines.en: Hold on a little longer and you will not wake.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，你动不了！
lines.en: Sssss, can't move!

lines.zh: 鬼压床来了！
lines.en: Paralysis hit!

lines.zh: 感觉身体被束缚！
lines.en: Feeling bound!

lines.zh: 你被鬼缠住了！
lines.en: Got you!

lines.zh: 无法呼吸，无法移动！
lines.en: Can't breathe, can't move!

lines.zh: 梦境吞噬了你！
lines.en: Dreams consume you!

lines.zh: 鬼影模糊，动弹不得！
lines.en: Foggy ghost, can't move!

lines.zh: 被黑暗包围，无法挣脱！
lines.en: Surrounded by darkness!

lines.zh: 你的灵魂被囚禁！
lines.en: Your soul is trapped!

lines.zh: 无法逃脱，只能等死！
lines.en: No escape, just die!

lines.zh: 它伸手，掐住你的呼吸。
lines.en: It reaches out and pinches off your breath.

lines.zh: 梦里的一击，你看不见。
lines.en: The blow lands in the dream, unseen.

lines.zh: 按住你的喉咙，轻轻用力。
lines.en: It presses your throat, gently tightening.

lines.zh: 你在梦中挨了一下。
lines.en: You take a hit inside the dream.

lines.zh: 它的指甲刮过你的梦。
lines.en: Its nails scrape across your dream.

lines.zh: 醒来之前，你得先受这一下。
lines.en: Before you wake, you must take this blow.

lines.zh: 天黑了，你该醒不过来。
lines.en: It's dark now; you shouldn't wake up.

lines.zh: 睡眠时分，我出没！
lines.en: Sleepy time, I emerge!

lines.zh: 梦里找你，不眠之夜！
lines.en: In your dreams, night never ends!

lines.zh: 你睡着了，我来了！
lines.en: You sleep, I come!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我靠近！
lines.en: Darkness, I approach!

lines.zh: 梦魇降临，你无法醒来！
lines.en: Nightmare, you can't wake!

lines.zh: 深夜，我游荡！
lines.en: Midnight, I wander!

lines.zh: 梦境里，我潜伏！
lines.en: Dreams, I lurk!

lines.zh: 躺下了，就醒不过来。
lines.en: Lie down and you won't wake up.

lines.zh: 你入梦，我现形！
lines.en: You dream, I appear!

lines.zh: 灯灭了，它坐在床沿。
lines.en: The lamp goes out, and it sits on the bed's edge.

lines.zh: 屏幕浮出：Can't wake up。
lines.en: The screen reads: Can't wake up.

lines.zh: 你睡着的那一刻，我来了。
lines.en: The moment you fall asleep, I arrive.

lines.zh: 理智值掉下去，我就出现。
lines.en: When your sanity drops, I appear.

lines.zh: 药片吃完了，我趁机进来。
lines.en: Your pills ran out, and I slipped in.

lines.zh: 梦境的门没关紧，我进来了。
lines.en: The dream door was ajar, so I came in.

lines.zh: 你梦见我，我就站在这里。
lines.en: You dream of me, and here I stand.

lines.zh: 梦的最深处，我坐起身。
lines.en: In the deepest part of the dream, I sit up.

lines.zh: 蒲公英暗了，我靠近了。
lines.en: The dandelion dims, and I draw near.

lines.zh: 深夜，我掀开你的被子。
lines.en: Deep in the night, I lift your blanket.

lines.zh: 你感觉身体被缠住了，挣脱不了，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You can't move! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我让你动不了，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You can't move! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 你动不了了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You can't move! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 你被我困住了，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You can't move! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 别想动弹，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You can't move! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 法术的光让我退到床角。
lines.en: The spell light drives me to the corner of the bed.

lines.zh: 动不了了，想哭啊，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You can't move! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷声里，我的影子晃了一下。
lines.en: In the thunder, my shadow wavers.

lines.zh: 我让你睡，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You can't move! — and the void makes it worse.
